paragraflar: How life appeared on Earth is a tricky question to answer because we lack conclusive evidence. According to one theory, life may have come with meteors in the form of bacteria. Bacteria can withstand excessive heat. Thus, they must have travelled vast distances in space and arrived on earth. To others, life must have originated on earth with the interaction of various chemicals. They believe that something must have caused these chemicals to interact. Changing climate, pressure, gravity or oxygen levels might have caused life on earth to appear.

B) some people who believe life began on Earth by chance
C) different theories about the beginning of life on Earth

C) one of the theories is more probable than the other

secenekler: A) Recent Studies into the History of Mankind
